name: smartcar-mg4
description: Full-stack Node.js app integrating with Smartcar API v3 for the MG4 X Range 2026

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend & wait
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npx ng build --configuration production
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../cli && npm install
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../cli && npx tsc --noEmit
